Gluten Fraud?

By: Albertus Louw | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Are certain outlets fraudulently profiting from health-conscious consumers’ willingness to pay a premium for gluten-free products? Can it have deadly consequences for those with real gluten allergie

Unique Selling Point:
A real-life drama of accusations and claims of victimization that not only affects every health-conscious consumer, but can potentially have severe health implications. Only deep investigation will help us solve this puzzle.

Summary:
A family in Fish Hoek experienced a serious medical emergency when their young son consumed falsely labeled gluten-free products and ended up in ICU.
People pointed fingers to a small bakery run by Natasha Mandiringa who sells products labeled as gluten-free. Natasha claims that she found a unique way to ferment gluten-free flours to bake goods that look and taste like wheat products.
The City of Cape Town’s Health directorate, as well as TOPIC, a non-profit organisation, went to investigate. They found Natasha very open and willing to get to the root of the problem. It seemed there were some misunderstandings and honest mistakes that she corrected and removed gluten-free labels from her products. The City of Cape Town was satisfied that Natasha now complied with the regulations.
But new allegations surfaced that Natasha was using wheat in her baking, without listing it as an ingredient. Staff at the bakery also informed clients verbally that the products did not contain gluten.
Dr Harris Steinman of FACTS (Food and Allergy Consulting Services) lab in Stellenbosch tested the products and found high levels of both gluten and wheat in the goods.
Natasha responded that people were running a vendetta against her and that the allegations were false. She does not have the resources to continually test all her products, but went to great lengths to ensure that she complied to all regulations.
Now, a health shop in Centurion is also selling gluten-free products that shows high levels of gluten in lab tests.
What is the truth? Are these business owners unscrupulous frauds taking advantage of health-conscious consumers or are they innovative entrepreneurs suffering a vendetta by competitors? Is it possible that gluten can be picked up in lab tests, even though the ingredients contain no gluten? Is the City of Cape Town shirking its responsibility by not properly investigating claims that could have serious consequences for its citizens?

Further information:
For 16-year old Michael Böttcher from Fish Hoek, gluten is highly toxic. We will follow his family’s journey of trying to keep gluten out of their home and how often other food sources get contaminated by gluten. Since his last close-call, Michael has been able to live a relatively healthy life, even playing for his school’s cricket team at the moment. But one mistake and everything can be over. He, himself, has done his own science experiments and found gluten in everything from chocolate to ice-cream.

We will speak to several experts about the science behind gluten and food allergies to put everything into context. We will buy products off the shelves of several outlets and have it tested at Dr Harris Steinman’s lab in Stellenbosch. We will confront those who are gambling with the lives of patients with serious gluten allergies.


Extra Budget Items:
Travel and accommodation for 2 crew members and presenter to Cape Town:
Flights
Car rental
Accommodation

Expert:
Dr. Harris Steinman
Dr. Marinda McDonald
Prof. Mike Levin

Locations:
Rosebank
Cape Town
Stellenbosch
Fish Hoek
Centurion

Hidden Camera: Yes
Reason for hidden camera: Needed for the following scenarios:
• Visiting both outlets to talk to the owners and shop assistants about the ingredients. Also to show us buying the products off the shelves.
• Discovering if allegations are true of wheat products being bought from other shops and re-packaged as wheat-free.
• Finding out if no wheat is really being used in products baked in the Freedom Bakery kitchen.

Legal: Yes
Reason for legal: To check legal implications of investigations.

Script:


VO

16-year old Michael Böttcher plays for Fish Hoek High School’s first cricket team – a feat for any grade 10 learner, but for Michael, it’s been especially tough to get here.
VO
Across the mountain lives Nicoletta di Gia- a working mom with an active lifestyle.
VO
For both Michael and Nicoletta, there’s one thing that can put a stop to even the most basic tasks.

LINK:
In most cultures, bread is the symbol of life. It has transcended its nutritional value – people gather to break bread... But what is mouth watering to you and I, is literally poison to others.

I use to wake up with open sores.
VO: Michael’s mother, Joanne, struggles to watch her son suffer.

Nobody knew what was wrong with him. He just started losing weight and he was dying, and I was going from one doctor to the next, from pillar to post, begging for help

You get desperate for help.

VO:Michael was eventually diagnosed with a severe form of Coeliac disease where the body’s own immune system attacks body tissues when you ingest gluten. His gastroenterologist is Dr David Epstein.

VO:Michael was eventually diagnosed with a severe form of Coeliac disease where the body’s own immune system attacks body tissues when you ingest gluten. His gastroenterologist is Dr David Epstein.

It’s an indescribable sort of pain, it’s not stabbing, it’s just painful, horrible.

People are using wheat bread in the same toaster as gluten-free bread. Even then, those tiny bits of crumbs, that tiny amount, can cause people to get ill.

VO:Dr Marinda McDonald specialises in allergies.

The coeliac patients really have an impaired quality of life and rely on accurate information.

IT’S FOR THIS REASON THAT GLUTEN-FREE BAKING DEVELOPED...BUT IT’S BECOME POPULAR EVEN WITH THOSE WHO DON’T HAVE COELIAC DISEASE.

In America, for example, up to 25% of people are either on a gluten-free diet or want to change to a gluten-free diet. Whereas the number of people who suffer with serious gluten-related illnesses in fact is very few.

Gluten-free products are more readily available and people opt for it as a life-style choice, because there is a fashionability to that.

VO: Paul Hartmann is an artisan baker who specialises in good old-fashioned slow fermented, wood-oven baked bread MADE WITH STONE-GROUND WHEAT FLOUR.

We’ve been eating bread for 10 000 years and in the last two years everybody is gluten intolerant. USE CUTAWAY OF CLAIRE OR WIDE SHOT OF INTERVIEW TO CUT TO NEXT SHOT OF PAUL

It’s the ingredients and how we treat the ingredients and how we make the bread. That’s the problem.

At his Woodstock bakery, the dough, is left to ferment for up to 52 hours.

By doing that we are de-naturing a lot of the gluten. And we are changing it so it is acceptable to our digestive system way more that high-speed quick bread on a commercial basis.

Professor Tim Noakes IS known for challenging CONVENTIONAL nutritional guidelines AND THE QUALITY OF MODERN wheat products.

Flour has been more and more refined and now the flour is different. The wheat that is grown is different than it was even 50 years ago and we don’t know all the changes that have occurred.
There are many people who’re suggesting that the glyphosate on the grains is causing us to change the gut flora and that is causing some of the problems. And that’s why when you take grains out of the diet, you’re not just removing gluten, you’re doing a whole lot of other things as well.

VO: FROM Coeliac patients to banters, CONSUMERS are willing to pay a premium for alternative breads.
Mass-produced whitebread in supermarkets start selling at around R9,00 A loaf. HOWEVER, a much smaller gluten-free loaf averages over R50. Some shops charge even more.
BUT IT CAN BE DIFFICULT TO TELL IF PRODUCTS REALLY ARE GLUTEN-FREE. WE SENT OUR TEAM TO BUY BREAD, SOLD AS GLUTEN-FREE, FROM A NUMBER OF OUTLETS, WITH THE VIEW To SEND THE BAKED GOODS TO THE LAB FOR SCIENTIFIC SCRUTINY.

VO: Our OPERATIVES visited THREE OUTLETS IN GAUTENG AND THE WESTERN CAPE. TO MAINTAIN THE CHAIN OF EVIDENCE WE FILMED THE ENTIRE PROCESS...from entering the shop to sealing the samples in bags.

VO:Nature’s Healing is a Centurion-based business THAT SELLS natural health products and OFFERS the services of a NATUROPATH.


IN THE SHOP, STAFF told us their products were gluten-free and THAT the listed ingredients were ALSO gluten-free.

Sound up: Yes, it’s gluten-free

VO:We established that THEIR BREAD COMES FROM A SUPPLIER CALLED Bella B.

AT another Centurion-based health supermarket, CALLED One Life Health we PURCHASED MORE breads THAT HAD COME FROM THE SAME SUPPLIER - Bella B, ALSO LABELLED Jemi Bread.

IN THIS SAME STORE, GLUTEN-FREE PRODUCTS ALSO COME FROM ANOTHER SUPPLIER, CALLED Green Valley Life.

If you have a look. This is the bread.

VO:TO GET SAMPLES STRAIGHT FROM THE TWO SUPPLIERS, WE MET Green Valley Life and Bella B REPRESENTATIVES WHO gave US MORE OF THEIR PRODUCTS, claimed to be gluten-free.

VO:IN CAPE TOWN, WE decided to revisit a bakery that had been the subject of consumer journalist, Wendy Knowler’s, investigations two years before.
Freedom Bakery IS ALSO A COFFEE SHOP AND SPECIALISES in baked produce from alternative flours.
THE BAKERY CLAIMS TO MAKE THEIR OWN PRODUCTS and OUR OPERATIVES could see only gluten-free ingredients on many of their products. For clarity we asked WHETHER this MEANT THE PRODUCTS WERE IN FACT GLUTEN-FREE?

Sound up:Are these rolls gluten-free?
Ja, coconut-based

VO:Natasha Mandiringa IS THE owner of Freedom Bakery. SHE CLAIMS TO HAVE DEVISED a special fermentation process that allowed her to use non-gluten flours to get THE amazing results in her baking THAT THE CUSTOMERS COME BACK FOR...

It’s amazing! Everybody that I serve it to would never say that it’s sugar-free, gluten-free and not that bad for you.

They use coconut flour, that’s what they said and xylitol, so no artficial sweeteners and no wheat. So it’s gluten-free.

The gluten is protein and almost like elastic bands that are forming together and holding each other even after bake. So if you tear it, there should be tearing. Like when you tear meat. There’s muscle fibre, there must be protein fibre in the bread when you break it apart. Gluten-free would be a very clean break or if there’s high fat in it, it would crumble like a muffin.

VO:IF YOU SIMPLY GO BY TOUCH AND FEEL, THE samples we BOUGHT RESEMBLE gluten-containing bread.

VO:SO THE QUESTION Remains -- IS THERE a breakthrough method to produce gluten-free bread that is so close to the real thing, one COULDN’T tell the difference? ONLY SCIENTIFIC TESTS COULD REVEAL THE TRUTH.

LINK
FACTS lab in Stellenbosch is one of the only accredited labs in South Africa that tests for food allergies.

VO:Our team delivered the samples IN PERSON and filmed THE breaking OF the seals BEFORE the scientists conducted a gluten test ON ALL OUR SAMPLES

VO:In line with the Codex Standard for gluten-free foods, South African legislation specifies that if you claim food is gluten free, it must contain no more than 20 gluten parts per million or 20 mg per kilogram.

So that would be the tip of a teaspoon to half a teaspoon of wheat flour.

VO:Food scientist, ALLERGY SPECIALIST, and owner of FACTS laboratory, Dr Harris Steinman, interpreted the test results.

We’ve diluted it down to measure that total amount of glutamine and you can therefore extrapolate how much wheat flour was used.

STEINMAN CONFIRMED THAT All OUR samples CONTAINED massive amounts of gluten -- RANGING from 40 000 to over 80 000 gluten parts per million. HE SAYS AN ORDINARY LOAF OF SUPERMARKET WHEAT BREAD CONTAINS 80 000 ppm

THE consequences for someone with a wheat allergy COULD BE DEADLY.

So in the most severe form, if you eat a hamburger bun that has wheat in it, you can have an anaphylactic reaction and it could be life-threatening. For a coeliac patient it can reactivate their disease and it can give them very significant symptoms in a very short space of time.

VO:TEST RESULTS IN HAND, WE RETURNED TO ONE LIFE HEALTH IN CENTURION FIRST. IN THE SHOPFRONT, ONLY THE SHOP MANAGER WAS AROUND TO RECEIVE US. SHE DEFENDED THEIR PRODUCTS.

A lot of the companies make these claims and the labels are very deceiving.

CLAIRE: They call it food fraud when you sell something, you label it one thing, but it’s actually something else, because it’s much more expensive for me to come and buy this loaf of bread which is R60. Remember, they’re using wheat, so they’re getting more money.

Ja, sure because the wheat is less expensive than the other ones.
What happens behind our backs in the bakery, we have no control over.

THE Owners of Nature’s healing, Aslam Mahomed and naturopath, Maimoona Mahomed confirmed that THEIR SUPPLIER is BELLA B.

Do you have an agreement with Bella B, is there a written contract or have they given you warranty so can you 100% trust the fact that what they supply have no gluten in?
So what Bella B has done and I’m very happy to say this. That as we speak, they’re having all these quality controls being tested to say their products have no gluten so far as they know. Because they also getting it from their suppliers.
So we tested something from Bella B and if you look here... Bella B... it was rolls that we bought and the reading there is 80 000 parts per million.
The ones that they wrote Gluten Free, actually have high amounts of gluten in.
Isit? Well, I’m not too happy about that to be honest, because I’m the supplier and I’m speaking to my clients and giving that this is gluten-free and if it’s not gluten, it’s not a good thing for me.

My main concern is my patients’ health.
VO: WE TRACKED DOWN BELLA-B OWNER, JASON NEILSON WHO SAYS THAT HE SOURCES HIS PRODUCTS FROM ANOTHER BAKERY - HE DOESN’T BAKE HIMSELF. HE WAS SHOCKED AT THE LABORATORY FINDINGS.
73 000
So what does that tell you?
That tells you it is almost a normal loaf of bread. Zero attempt was made for it to be gluten-free.
You are trying to do everything right and obviously these are showing absolutely the opposite.
It is terrible. I’m not walking away very happy at this point in time. quite upset about that.

VO:JASON HANDED OVER THE PHONE NUMBER FOR HIS BAKER -- BETTER SIBANDA, WHOSE bakery is in Orange Grove, JOHANNESBURG.
Do you bake gluten-free products?
No...
You don’t bake gluten-free products?
No
We have been told that you are selling gluten-free..
By who?
By one of the people that you supply to
Who is the people that I supply?
Maybe we can sit down and chat about that.

No, no, no, I don’t run my life on the media. Please. I’m sorry...
VO: In Cape Town, AT Freedom Bakery, Natasha Mandiringa WHO HAD BEEN THE SUBJECT OF A PREVIOUS INVESTIGATION, SEEMED UNPERTURBED BY OUR NEW LAB RESULTS.
Who say somebody is claiming gluten-free?
Are you saying you are not a gluten-free bakery?
I did not claim gluten-free.
OK
Not at all

VO: BUT OUR RESEARCH SHOWED THAT customers OF FREEDOM BAKERY ARE under the impression THE products are gluten free.
Where is it written?
Your ingredients don’t have any gluten. There is no gluten in any of the ingredients that you use to make the products.
Because that’s the ingredients I use.
OK, so then where does the gluten enter? Should the final product then also not be gluten-free?
That’s right.
But it can’t be gluten-free because when we tested it, there was gluten in.
That’s your results.

Sound up: Are these rolls gluten-free?
Ja, coconut-based.

VO: Attorney Janusz Luterek specialises in consumer protection and food law.
If I tell a consumer something is gluten-free, but it’s not. Whether it’s on the label would not be the determinate situation.

VO: BACK IN Gauteng, WE TRACKED DOWN GREEN VALLEY LIFE, WHICH SUPPLIED TO THE ONE LIFE HEALTH SUPERMARKET. OWNER, Raven Rambally, SAYS the bakery that supplies him, assured him the bread only contained gluten-free ingredients. He says he will stop supply and investigate.

“It is shocking to me and surprising because we are supplying these breads to our customers for the past five years, who are gluten intolerant and they have coeliac disease certified medically and not one has come back to state that your bread has made us sick, look further.

VO: OUR INVESTIGATION REVEALED THAT WHILE SOME LABELLED GLUTEN-CONTAINING BREAD GLUTEN-FREE...OTHERS SEEMED TO SKIRT THE ISSUE BY LISTING GLUTEN-FREE INGREDIENTS, AND SIMPLY OMITTING GLUTEN FROM THEIR LIST.

Claire: If a baker deliberately lies about using only gluten free ingredients. What are those legal implications?

Fraud. It’s fraud. All gluten-free products cost more than more non-gluten free products. So by lying to you and deceiving you intentionally about what ingredients I have used so that I can get a higher price from you, I have actually committed normal fraud. You can go to the police station and lay a charge of fraud.

Sound up: Yes, it’s gluten-free VO:We established that THEIR BREAD COMES FROM A SUPPLIER CALLED Bella B. AT another Centurion-based health supermarket, CALLED One Life Health we PURCHASED MORE breads THAT HAD COME FROM THE SAME SUPPLIER - Bella B, ALSO LABELLED Jemi Bread. IN THIS SAME STORE, GLUTEN-FREE PRODUCTS ALSO COME FROM ANOTHER SUPPLIER, CALLED Green Valley Life. If you have a look. This is the bread. VO:TO GET SAMPLES STRAIGHT FROM THE TWO SUPPLIERS, WE MET Green Valley Life and Bella B REPRESENTATIVES WHO gave US MORE OF THEIR PRODUCTS, claimed to be gluten-free. VO:IN CAPE TOWN, WE decided to revisit a bakery that had been the subject of consumer journalist, Wendy Knowler’s, investigations two years before. Freedom Bakery IS ALSO A COFFEE SHOP AND SPECIALISES in baked produce from alternative flours. THE BAKERY CLAIMS TO MAKE THEIR OWN PRODUCTS and OUR OPERATIVES could see only gluten-free ingredients on many of their products. For clarity we asked WHETHER this MEANT THE PRODUCTS WERE IN FACT GLUTEN-FREE? Sound up:Are these rolls gluten-free? Ja, coconut-based VO:Natasha Mandiringa IS THE owner of Freedom Bakery. SHE CLAIMS TO HAVE DEVISED a special fermentation process that allowed her to use non-gluten flours to get THE amazing results in her baking THAT THE CUSTOMERS COME BACK FOR... It’s amazing! Everybody that I serve it to would never say that it’s sugar-free, gluten-free and not that bad for you. They use coconut flour, that’s what they said and xylitol, so no artficial sweeteners and no wheat. So it’s gluten-free. The gluten is protein and almost like elastic bands that are forming together and holding each other even after bake. So if you tear it, there should be tearing. Like when you tear meat. There’s muscle fibre, there must be protein fibre in the bread when you break it apart. Gluten-free would be a very clean break or if there’s high fat in it, it would crumble like a muffin. VO:IF YOU SIMPLY GO BY TOUCH AND FEEL, THE samples we BOUGHT RESEMBLE gluten-containing bread. VO:SO THE QUESTION Remains -- IS THERE a breakthrough method to produce gluten-free bread that is so close to the real thing, one COULDN’T tell the difference? ONLY SCIENTIFIC TESTS COULD REVEAL THE TRUTH. LINK FACTS lab in Stellenbosch is one of the only accredited labs in South Africa that tests for food allergies. VO:Our team delivered the samples IN PERSON and filmed THE breaking OF the seals BEFORE the scientists conducted a gluten test ON ALL OUR SAMPLES VO:In line with the Codex Standard for gluten-free foods, South African legislation specifies that if you claim food is gluten free, it must contain no more than 20 gluten parts per million or 20 mg per kilogram. So that would be the tip of a teaspoon to half a teaspoon of wheat flour. VO:Food scientist, ALLERGY SPECIALIST, and owner of FACTS laboratory, Dr Harris Steinman, interpreted the test results. We’ve diluted it down to measure that total amount of glutamine and you can therefore extrapolate how much wheat flour was used. STEINMAN CONFIRMED THAT All OUR samples CONTAINED massive amounts of gluten -- RANGING from 40 000 to over 80 000 gluten parts per million. HE SAYS AN ORDINARY LOAF OF SUPERMARKET WHEAT BREAD CONTAINS 80 000 ppm THE consequences for someone with a wheat allergy COULD BE DEADLY. So in the most severe form, if you eat a hamburger bun that has wheat in it, you can have an anaphylactic reaction and it could be life-threatening. For a coeliac patient it can reactivate their disease and it can give them very significant symptoms in a very short space of time. VO:TEST RESULTS IN HAND, WE RETURNED TO ONE LIFE HEALTH IN CENTURION FIRST. IN THE SHOPFRONT, ONLY THE SHOP MANAGER WAS AROUND TO RECEIVE US. SHE DEFENDED THEIR PRODUCTS. A lot of the companies make these claims and the labels are very deceiving. CLAIRE: They call it food fraud when you sell something, you label it one thing, but it’s actually something else, because it’s much more expensive for me to come and buy this loaf of bread which is R60. Remember, they’re using wheat, so they’re getting more money. Ja, sure because the wheat is less expensive than the other ones. What happens behind our backs in the bakery, we have no control over. THE Owners of Nature’s healing, Aslam Mahomed and naturopath, Maimoona Mahomed confirmed that THEIR SUPPLIER is BELLA B. Do you have an agreement with Bella B, is there a written contract or have they given you warranty so can you 100% trust the fact that what they supply have no gluten in? So what Bella B has done and I’m very happy to say this. That as we speak, they’re having all these quality controls being tested to say their products have no gluten so far as they know. Because they also getting it from their suppliers. So we tested something from Bella B and if you look here... Bella B... it was rolls that we bought and the reading there is 80 000 parts per million. The ones that they wrote Gluten Free, actually have high amounts of gluten in. Isit? Well, I’m not too happy about that to be honest, because I’m the supplier and I’m speaking to my clients and giving that this is gluten-free and if it’s not gluten, it’s not a good thing for me. My main concern is my patients’ health. VO: WE TRACKED DOWN BELLA-B OWNER, JASON NEILSON WHO SAYS THAT HE SOURCES HIS PRODUCTS FROM ANOTHER BAKERY - HE DOESN’T BAKE HIMSELF. HE WAS SHOCKED AT THE LABORATORY FINDINGS. 73 000 So what does that tell you? That tells you it is almost a normal loaf of bread. Zero attempt was made for it to be gluten-free. You are trying to do everything right and obviously these are showing absolutely the opposite. It is terrible. I’m not walking away very happy at this point in time. quite upset about that. VO:JASON HANDED OVER THE PHONE NUMBER FOR HIS BAKER -- BETTER SIBANDA, WHOSE bakery is in Orange Grove, JOHANNESBURG. Do you bake gluten-free products? No... You don’t bake gluten-free products? No We have been told that you are selling gluten-free.. By who? By one of the people that you supply to Who is the people that I supply? Maybe we can sit down and chat about that. No, no, no, I don’t run my life on the media. Please. I’m sorry... VO: In Cape Town, AT Freedom Bakery, Natasha Mandiringa WHO HAD BEEN THE SUBJECT OF A PREVIOUS INVESTIGATION, SEEMED UNPERTURBED BY OUR NEW LAB RESULTS. Who say somebody is claiming gluten-free? Are you saying you are not a gluten-free bakery? I did not claim gluten-free. OK Not at all VO: BUT OUR RESEARCH SHOWED THAT customers OF FREEDOM BAKERY ARE under the impression THE products are gluten free. Where is it written? Your ingredients don’t have any gluten. There is no gluten in any of the ingredients that you use to make the products. Because that’s the ingredients I use. OK, so then where does the gluten enter? Should the final product then also not be gluten-free? That’s right. But it can’t be gluten-free because when we tested it, there was gluten in. That’s your results. Sound up: Are these rolls gluten-free? Ja, coconut-based. VO: Attorney Janusz Luterek specialises in consumer protection and food law. If I tell a consumer something is gluten-free, but it’s not. Whether it’s on the label would not be the determinate situation. VO: BACK IN Gauteng, WE TRACKED DOWN GREEN VALLEY LIFE, WHICH SUPPLIED TO THE ONE LIFE HEALTH SUPERMARKET. OWNER, Raven Rambally, SAYS the bakery that supplies him, assured him the bread only contained gluten-free ingredients. He says he will stop supply and investigate. “It is shocking to me and surprising because we are supplying these breads to our customers for the past five years, who are gluten intolerant and they have coeliac disease certified medically and not one has come back to state that your bread has made us sick, look further. VO: OUR INVESTIGATION REVEALED THAT WHILE SOME LABELLED GLUTEN-CONTAINING BREAD GLUTEN-FREE...OTHERS SEEMED TO SKIRT THE ISSUE BY LISTING GLUTEN-FREE INGREDIENTS, AND SIMPLY OMITTING GLUTEN FROM THEIR LIST. Claire: If a baker deliberately lies about using only gluten free ingredients. What are those legal implications? Fraud. It’s fraud. All gluten-free products cost more than more non-gluten free products. So by lying to you and deceiving you intentionally about what ingredients I have used so that I can get a higher price from you, I have actually committed normal fraud. You can go to the police station and lay a charge of fraud.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Are certain outlets fraudulently profiting from health-conscious consumers’ willingness to pay a premium for gluten-free products? Can it have deadly consequences for those with real gluten allergie
metadata.Unique Selling Point: A real-life drama of accusations and claims of victimization that not only affects every health-conscious consumer, but can potentially have severe health implications. Only deep investigation will help us solve this puzzle.
metadata.Summary: A family in Fish Hoek experienced a serious medical emergency when their young son consumed falsely labeled gluten-free products and ended up in ICU. People pointed fingers to a small bakery run by Natasha Mandiringa who sells products labeled as gluten-free. Natasha claims that she found a unique way to ferment gluten-free flours to bake goods that look and taste like wheat products. The City of Cape Town’s Health directorate, as well as TOPIC, a non-profit organisation, went to investigate. They found Natasha very open and willing to get to the root of the problem. It seemed there were some misunderstandings and honest mistakes that she corrected and removed gluten-free labels from her products. The City of Cape Town was satisfied that Natasha now complied with the regulations. But new allegations surfaced that Natasha was using wheat in her baking, without listing it as an ingredient. Staff at the bakery also informed clients verbally that the products did not contain gluten. Dr Harris Steinman of FACTS (Food and Allergy Consulting Services) lab in Stellenbosch tested the products and found high levels of both gluten and wheat in the goods. Natasha responded that people were running a vendetta against her and that the allegations were false. She does not have the resources to continually test all her products, but went to great lengths to ensure that she complied to all regulations. Now, a health shop in Centurion is also selling gluten-free products that shows high levels of gluten in lab tests. What is the truth? Are these business owners unscrupulous frauds taking advantage of health-conscious consumers or are they innovative entrepreneurs suffering a vendetta by competitors? Is it possible that gluten can be picked up in lab tests, even though the ingredients contain no gluten? Is the City of Cape Town shirking its responsibility by not properly investigating claims that could have serious consequences for its citizens?
metadata.Further information: For 16-year old Michael Böttcher from Fish Hoek, gluten is highly toxic. We will follow his family’s journey of trying to keep gluten out of their home and how often other food sources get contaminated by gluten. Since his last close-call, Michael has been able to live a relatively healthy life, even playing for his school’s cricket team at the moment. But one mistake and everything can be over. He, himself, has done his own science experiments and found gluten in everything from chocolate to ice-cream. We will speak to several experts about the science behind gluten and food allergies to put everything into context. We will buy products off the shelves of several outlets and have it tested at Dr Harris Steinman’s lab in Stellenbosch. We will confront those who are gambling with the lives of patients with serious gluten allergies.
